spec.name: GoldSessionMomentumBreakout
spec.hypothesis: XAUUSD exhibits persistent intraday momentum following the London and New York session opens due to institutional order flow clustering and liquidity provision cycles. Market makers and algorithmic execution desks concentrate volume during these windows, creating directional imbalances that persist for several hours. Retail traders often fade initial moves or enter late after exhaustion, providing the counterparty liquidity for institutional trend continuation. This strategy captures the first-hour breakout of the session range as a proxy for committed institutional direction.
spec.entry_logic: Enter long when price breaks above the current session's high (London or NY) within the first 120 minutes of session open, and ATR confirms sufficient volatility. Enter short on break below session low under same conditions.
spec.exit_logic: Stop loss set at max(5.0, 1.5 * ATR) USD points from entry. Take profit set at max(7.5, 2.5 * ATR) USD points. No trailing stop; fixed R:R ensures statistical consistency across varying volatility regimes.
filters: Only trade during active London or NY session hours
Require minimum ATR threshold to avoid low-volatility false breaks
Entry only valid within first 120 minutes of session open
spec.expected_failure_conditions: Extended Asian-session dominance with suppressed London/NY volatility; major central bank announcements causing gap reversals beyond ATR-based stops

details.detail: Bit-identical signal tapes produced on two independent runs with seed=42.
Verified signal identity T_c[0..c] == T_full[0..c] across 20 cut points (tolerance 1e-9).
